input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble sending MMS messages with my messaging app. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’m currently in France. Can you help me fix this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information.
I just tried, but I’m still unable to send MMS messages. What should I do next?

Here’s what I see on my status bar:
- I have poor signal strength (just one bar),
- It shows 2G,
- Mobile data is enabled,
- Airplane Mode is off,
- I don’t see any VPN icons.

What should I do next?

I changed my network mode to “4G/5G preferred,” and now I have excellent signal strength with 5G showing on my status bar. I also checked, and I’m now able to send MMS messages successfully!

Thank you for your help—looks like the issue is resolved.
Thank you so much for your help! I appreciate it. Have a great day! ###STOP###

- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth, or

This will help me assist you further.

Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I just tried, but I’m still unable to send MMS messages. What should I do next?

Let’s continue troubleshooting. Please follow these steps on your phone:

1. Check if you have a good cellular signal and that mobile data is enabled.
2. Make sure Airplane Mode is OFF.
3. Ensure you are not connected to a VPN.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- If you see any signal bars,
- If mobile data is enabled,
- If Airplane Mode is on,
- If you see any VPN icons?

This will help me identify the next steps.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Here’s what I see on my status bar:
- I have poor signal strength (just one bar),
- It shows 2G,
- Mobile data is enabled,
- Airplane Mode is off,
- I don’t see any VPN icons.

What should I do next?

Thank you for the details. MMS requires at least a 3G network connection—2G is generally not sufficient for sending or receiving MMS.

Please change your network mode preference to allow your phone to connect to 3G, 4G, or 5G networks. On your device, look for the option to set your network mode and select “4G/5G preferred” or “4G only” if available.

Once you’ve changed the network mode, wait a moment for your phone to reconnect, then try sending an MMS again. Let me know if this resolves the issue or if you need further assistance.

Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app can send MMS messages.

I changed my network mode to “4G/5G preferred,” and now I have excellent signal strength with 5G showing on my status bar. I also checked, and I’m now able to send MMS messages successfully!

Thank you for your help—looks like the issue is resolved.

I’m glad to hear that changing your network mode resolved the issue and you’re now able to send MMS messages successfully!

If you have any other questions or need further assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Safe travels in France!
